<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 131.87, 129.70 (appearing twice), 129.01 (appearing twice) and 129.00 ppm. This pattern corresponds to a monosubstituted benzene ring, which contains six aromatic carbon atoms (some signals overlap). Therefore, the compound has 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
